title: Scopes: per-party credentials
summary: Per-party secrets at secrets/parties/<id>/<name> (0600 enforced on write and read) with a scope record (read-only or write, rotate-by date, owner), resolved only through scopes.secret(party, name), which refuses a write-scope key to a caller asking for read; rotation-due events go to intake.

tools.purpose: per-party credentials with scope records; secret() refuses a write key to a reader

limits.why: the module's own caps; shipped closed, opened only by the owner

meters.why: every key added or rotated (never the value)
